purpose: Teach: 被疑/面会/先送り/白紙/水質/非公式/たたき台/商事

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 被疑のかかる経営者、若い頃に見たことがある。
lines.en: I've seen executives caught up in suspicions like this before, back when I was younger.
lines.style: Measured, unhurried. Voice settles on the weight of memory. Slight pause after the first clause—he's retrieving something old. Quiet authority in the observation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。弁護士との面会、初動が肝心です。
lines.en: Yes. The lawyer consultation—how you respond at the start will determine everything.
lines.style: Direct and focused. Sharp attention on 「初動」. Composed but with underlying tension. Speaking as someone who understands the stakes and the clock.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 先送りは、組織の信頼を失う。
lines.en: Delaying this will erode the organization's trust—that damage is irreversible.
lines.style: Quiet firmness. No hedging. Each phrase lands with weight. Speaking from experience of what broken trust looks like. Measured cadence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 広報、白紙覚悟で挑みます。
lines.en: Our PR approach—I'm prepared to start from scratch if that's what's needed.
lines.style: Steady conviction. Lean into the commitment on 「覚悟」. Calm resolution, not panic. The voice of someone who has already made the hard choice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 水質、環境、現代の企業の必須課題だ。
lines.en: Water quality and environmental responsibility—these aren't optional for companies anymore. They're foundational.
lines.style: Authoritative but not cold. A slight lift on the observation—this is principle speaking. Measured pacing. The tone of someone stating inevitable fact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 非公式な情報ルート、信頼関係で築きます。
lines.en: I'll build those informal information channels carefully—trust is the only currency that matters here.
lines.style: Steady and assured. Soft emphasis on 「信頼関係」. Speaking with pragmatic understanding. Not rehearsed—deliberate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: たたき台、自分でも書いていた、現役の頃は。
lines.en: I used to draft these approaches myself, back when I was still in the role. It's coming back now.
lines.style: Nostalgic but grounded. A small smile behind the words—the muscle memory of expertise returning. Unhurried, reflective. The ease of old competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 商事業界、長期視点で取り組みます。
lines.en: The trading industry requires patience and perspective—we're thinking years ahead, not just days.
lines.style: Final thought, measured and composed. Settling into wisdom. A slight broadening of view in the second clause. The voice of someone offering hard-won perspective.
